In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], an '''agent of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]''' attempted to aid [[Shemza|Doc Shemza]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]], on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Shemza was abducted by thugs, but eventually rescued by a group of vacationing former-students from [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo's]] [[Royal House of Learning/Legends|Royal House of Learning]]. Shemza, accompanied by the Rebel agent's droid, [[Shorty (droid)|Shorty]], and the vacationing students, lead the way to [[Landing Platform 21]]. Along the way, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] attempted to [[Occupation of Bespin|occupy the planet]]. Shemza's contact flew the group to safety.
